# `<cpio.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Finding files in a cpio archive (new ASCII format), as used for the initrd.

```c
#include <cpio.h>
```

## Structures

### `cpio_hdr_t` { #cpio_hdr_t }

A cpio member header: 110 bytes, numbers as 8 hex digits.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `magic` | `char` | "070701". |
| `ino` | `char` | Inode number. |
| `mode` | `char` | File mode. |
| `uid` | `char` | Owner. |
| `gid` | `char` | Group. |
| `nlink` | `char` | Link count. |
| `mtime` | `char` | Modification time. |
| `filesize` | `char` | Size of the file data. |
| `devmajor` | `char` | Major number of the device holding the file. |
| `devminor` | `char` | Minor number of that device. |
| `rdevmajor` | `char` | Major number, for device files. |
| `rdevminor` | `char` | Minor number, for device files. |
| `namesize` | `char` | Length of the name that follows, including the NUL. |
| `check` | `char` | Always 0. |

## Functions

### `CpioFind` { #cpiofind }

```c
bool CpioFind(const void *base, size_t size, const char *name, const void **data_out, size_t *size_out);
```

Finds a file in a CPIO archive.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `base` | in | Start of the archive in memory. |
| `size` | in | Size of the archive in bytes. |
| `name` | in | Name of the file to find. |
| `data_out` | out | Receives a pointer to the file's data, inside the archive. |
| `size_out` | out | Receives the size of the file's data. |

**Returns:** true if the file was found, false otherwise.
